invariants.rationale: Since the method returns a new instance of JavaHoodieBackedTableMetadataWriter, result must be non-null.
conf is a parameter used to create the result and must be non-null as it is passed to the constructor.
writeConfig is passed to the constructor and must be non-null.
context is passed to the constructor and must be non-null.
The result is an instance of JavaHoodieBackedTableMetadataWriter as created by the method.
